name: gb-is-my-strength
description: Build scripts for gospod-bog.ru — AUDIT V2 + AUDIT_10_OF_10 patches applied.

scripts.migration:metadata:check: npm run route:profiles:check && npm run migration:matrix:check && npm run content:sources:check && npm run surface:registry:check
scripts.migration:metadata:check:strict: npm run route:profiles:check -- --strict && npm run migration:matrix:check -- --strict && npm run content:sources:check -- --strict && npm run surface:registry:check
scripts.validate:seo: npm run seo-audit && npm run validate
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:strict && npm run seo-audit
scripts.ci:check: npm run cache-bust && npm run validate:static-publication && npm run workflows:check
scripts.engine:guard: npm run engine:contracts && npm run gill:chrome:guard && npm run engine:sweep
scripts.validate:publication: npm run validate:static-publication && npm run interactive-audit
scripts.validate:static-publication: npm run validate:all && npm run owner:ui-guard && npm run about:visual-parity:audit && npm run biografii:visual-parity:audit && npm run hard-texts:visual-parity:audit && npm run pastor-series:visual-parity:audit && npm run articles:visual-parity:audit && npm run gill:context:visual-parity:audit && npm run gill:spravochnik:visual-parity:audit && npm run konfessii:visual-parity:audit && npm run karty:visual-parity:audit && npm run baptisty-rossii:visual-parity:audit && npm run home:visual-parity:audit && npm run nagornaya:visual-parity:audit && npm run catalogs:visual-parity:audit && npm run baptisty:roadmap:audit && npm run baptisty:visual-atlas:audit && npm run maps:validate && npm run page-ownership:check && npm run avraam:audit && npm run tokens:check && npm run css:layer:validate && node scripts/audit-pro.js && npm run content:parity && npm run sources:hygiene && npm run article:qa && npm run readable-audit && npm run editorial:lint && npm run gill:reading-time:audit && npm run gill:pagefind:audit && npm run gill:series:data:consistency:audit && npm run data:consistency && npm run content:guard && npm run astro:audit:article-mdx:strict && npm run astro:audit:baptisty-series && npm run mdx:structure:audit && npm run contract:compare && npm run migration:metadata:check:strict && npm run sw:dist:audit
scripts.content:baseline:dist:check: npm run contract:extract:dist && npm run contract:compare:dist
scripts.astro:build: npm run dist:clean && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.contract:compare:dist:about: npm run contract:extract:dist && node scripts/compare-url-contract.js --baseline data/public-content-baseline.json --current reports/url-contract-dist.json --only-url https://gospod-bog.ru/about/
scripts.astro:pilot:about: npm run astro:build && npm run contract:compare:dist:about
scripts.strangler:build: npm run astro:build && node scripts/copy-legacy-to-dist.js && node scripts/astro-cache-bust-postbuild.js
scripts.strangler:build:production-like: npm run astro:build && node scripts/copy-legacy-to-dist.js --omit-build-only && node scripts/astro-cache-bust-postbuild.js
scripts.strangler:validate: npm run strangler:build && npm run page-ownership:dist && npm run contract:extract:dist && npm run contract:compare:dist
scripts.strangler:audit: npm run strangler:build && npm run page-ownership:dist && node scripts/dist-publication-audit.js
scripts.strangler:audit:pagefind: npm run strangler:build && npm run page-ownership:dist && npm run pagefind:build:dist && node scripts/dist-publication-audit.js --require-pagefind && npm run contract:extract:dist && npm run contract:compare:dist && node scripts/dist-smoke-audit.js --no-build
scripts.strangler:audit:production-like: npm run strangler:build:production-like && npm run page-ownership:dist:production-like && npm run pagefind:build:dist && node scripts/dist-publication-audit.js --require-pagefind --forbid-dev && npm run contract:extract:dist && npm run contract:compare:dist && npm run dist:jsonld:audit && npm run schema:rich-results:audit:dist && npm run audit:premium-controls && node scripts/gill-context-visual-parity-audit.js --require-dist && node scripts/gill-spravochnik-visual-parity-audit.js --require-dist && npm run gill:mobile-play:smoke && node scripts/dist-smoke-audit.js --no-build --production-like && npm run dist:css-parity && npm run content:coverage:audit && npm run sw:dist:audit:pagefind
scripts.strangler:deploy-readiness: npm run astro:audit:about && npm run astro:audit:home && npm run astro:audit:ishod && npm run astro:audit:legacy-wrappers && npm run astro:audit:article-mdx:strict && npm run astro:audit:baptisty-series && npm run strangler:audit:production-like && npm run visual:parity:production
scripts.astro:pilot:article-mdx: npm run strangler:build && npm run page-ownership:dist
scripts.source:links:dist: npm run strangler:build:production-like && node scripts/source-link-audit.js --root dist
scripts.visual:parity:guard: npm run visual:parity:screenshots:landings -- --warn-only && npm run visual:parity:baseline:check
scripts.validate:static-publication:light: npm run validate:all && npm run owner:ui-guard && npm run about:visual-parity:audit && npm run biografii:visual-parity:audit && npm run hard-texts:visual-parity:audit && npm run pastor-series:visual-parity:audit && npm run articles:visual-parity:audit && npm run gill:context:visual-parity:audit && npm run gill:spravochnik:visual-parity:audit && npm run konfessii:visual-parity:audit && npm run karty:visual-parity:audit && npm run baptisty-rossii:visual-parity:audit && npm run home:visual-parity:audit && npm run nagornaya:visual-parity:audit && npm run catalogs:visual-parity:audit && npm run baptisty:roadmap:audit && npm run baptisty:visual-atlas:audit && npm run maps:validate && npm run page-ownership:check && npm run avraam:audit && npm run tokens:check && npm run css:layer:validate && node scripts/audit-pro.js && npm run content:parity && npm run sources:hygiene && npm run article:qa && npm run readable-audit && npm run editorial:lint && npm run gill:reading-time:audit && npm run gill:pagefind:audit && npm run gill:series:data:consistency:audit && npm run data:consistency && npm run content:guard && npm run mdx:structure:audit && npm run contract:compare && npm run migration:metadata:check:strict && npm run astro:audit:article-mdx:strict && npm run astro:audit:baptisty-series && npm run sw:dist:audit
